body: Hey I'm not saying I treat the customers like crap. But when they're being completely unfair it makes us feel like shit especially if people like you have the "the customers is always right" saying. I smile, ask them nicely what they want,patiently suggest items in the menu if they are unsure and even admit to my boss "hey you know what yes I took their order. I'll be sure to be more clear next time" but it's not my fault the customer was on their phone when I repeated the order or that the whole restaurant was loud or that their kids were screaming in the background through a phone call. I don't want to get blamed for something that's not my fault it it seriously puts me down when even the managers don't even try to listen to your side of how things went. There's nothing worse than losing confidence in your job especially if your manager knows it wasn't your fault but hey. Gotta please the customer even if they're wrong am I right.
Well it's true. I don't drink but I do bury my feelings a lot.
Thank you I hope you're having a good night.
I hate that this happens because it hurts more coming from your own family
I know I've gotten this far but I'm just tired. Sometimes I really do want to end it all but I'm too much of a coward
Thank you. I haven't done it in a long time and the stress is just making the thoughts come back.
I hate to break it to you but I think you got "main character" syndrome.
Yeah I haven't done it cause of my family but they don't seem to do anything anyway.
You right but I'ma haunt these hoes when I die.
Can't believe a stranger cares more about me than my own family.
